scenario_description: Insured dies from natural causes after 5 years; premiums paid; no loans.
Insured dies by suicide 10 months after issue.
Insured dies by suicide exactly 13 months after issue.
Insured dies from natural illness in month 14.

Both joint insureds have died; second insured has just died.
Owner cancels 20 days after receiving policy and requests full refund.
After several years, the policy owner stops paying premiums and neither surrenders the policy nor selects a non-forfeiture option within 60 days of lapse.
